title.zh: 共同活动中的差别制造

statement.zh: 固定实际所取的动作，but-for 检验由一方的部分推广到一同扣除的若干部分，一条定律确切说明若干部分何时只有一同才造成差别。多重决定下 but-for 与关系参与分离：一个汲取者的部分不造成差别，关系读法仍把它计为消耗。
statement.en: With the move held fixed, the but-for test extends to parts withheld together, and a law states exactly when parts make a difference only together. Under overdetermination, but-for and participation come apart: a drawer's part makes no difference, yet the relational reading counts it as consuming.

laws.zh: 配置之间依存的维持与断裂互斥，沿运行恰是依存动力学的维持与断裂。
laws.en: Keeping and breaking a dependence between configurations are exclusive, and along a run they are exactly the keeping and breaking of the dependence dynamics.

laws.zh: but-for 检验固定实际所取的动作：由某配置以某动作的一步断裂依存，而扣除某一方的部分后同一动作仍可取、且以它的每一步都维持依存，则这一方的部分造成了差别；一同扣除若干部分时如此，则它们一同造成差别；单独一个部分是只含一项的情形。
laws.en: The but-for test holds the move actually taken fixed: a party's part makes the difference when the step from a configuration by a move breaks a dependence and, with that part withheld, the same move can still be taken and every step by it keeps the dependence; parts make it together when this holds with all of them withheld, and one part is the one-element case.

laws.zh: 对单独一个部分，在每个过程中、不需动作决定步骤：这一步断裂依存、扣除该部分后动作可取、依存在那里成立并被满足时，该部分造成差别，当且仅当同一动作不再断裂依存。
laws.en: For one part, in every process and without determinacy: where the step breaks the dependence, the move can be taken with the part withheld, and the dependence holds and is met there, the part makes the difference exactly when the same move no longer breaks the dependence.

laws.zh: 动作决定步骤时，由依存成立并被满足的配置，动作断裂依存，当且仅当到达的水平低于所需。
laws.en: When the move determines the step, from a configuration where the dependence holds and is met the move breaks it exactly when the level it reaches is below the need.

laws.zh: 因此，这一步断裂依存、动作决定步骤并在扣除后可取、依存在扣除后的配置上仍成立并被满足时，检验是二分的：或者那一部分造成差别，或者同一动作仍断裂依存。
laws.en: So where the step breaks the dependence, the move determines the step and can be taken after withholding, and the dependence still holds and is met at the withheld configuration, the test is a dichotomy: either the part makes the difference or the same move still breaks the dependence.

laws.zh: 扣除任何单独一方的部分、以同一动作仍有断裂之步，为多重决定；此时没有哪一方单独造成差别，凡一同扣除即维持依存的若干部分，都只有一同才造成差别。
laws.en: The loss is overdetermined when, with any single part withheld, the same move still breaks the dependence; then no single part makes the difference, and every set of parts whose withholding keeps the dependence makes it only together.

laws.zh: 共同差别制造之律：动作决定步骤，且单独扣除任何一个成员的部分后同一动作仍可取、依存在那里仍成立并被满足时，这些部分一同造成差别而没有哪个成员单独造成差别，当且仅当一同扣除它们维持依存，而单独扣除其中任何一个，同一动作仍断裂依存。
laws.en: The law of joint difference-making: where the move determines the step and, with any single member's part withheld, can still be taken and leaves the dependence holding and met, the parts make the difference together while no member alone makes it exactly when withholding all of them keeps the dependence and withholding any one of them leaves the same move breaking it.

laws.zh: 由右到左一向在每个过程中成立；只有一同才造成的差别至少需要两个部分。
laws.en: The direction from right to left holds in every process, and a difference made only together needs at least two parts.

laws.zh: Pool 是这一共同定律的实例，它的过程与 Shock 的一样由动作决定步骤：同一过程、同一水平，第一个汲取者取同样的量：另有一方汲取时，它的部分造成差别；另有两方汲取时损失被多重决定，它的部分不造成差别，而前两个汲取者只有一同才造成差别，差别由共同活动造成。
laws.en: Pool is an instance, its process, like Shock's, determined by the move: in one process at one level with the first drawer taking the same amount, with one other drawer its part makes the difference; with two others the loss is overdetermined, its part makes none, and the first two drawers make the difference only together, so the difference belongs to the joint activity.

laws.zh: 两次运行中，关系读法都把第一个汲取者计为消耗，一个什么也不取的形成不计为消耗。
laws.en: In both runs the relational reading counts the first drawer as consuming, and a formation that takes nothing is not.

laws.zh: 一个形成的各事件之间须分开整段与步层面的检验：在可更新条件的过程中每步汲取两个单位，条件被消耗；第一个事件那一步维持依存，对任何正长度的周期都不侵蚀；扣除任何一个事件的汲取，甚至扣除任何一步之前的全部汲取，条件仍被消耗，整段的结局由尾部决定。
laws.en: Across a formation's own events the run-level and step-level tests come apart: drawing two units at every step in the renewable process consumes the condition; the first event's step keeps the dependence and undermines for no positive cycle; with any single event's draw withheld, indeed with every draw before any step withheld, the condition is still consumed, the run-level outcome being fixed by the tail.

laws.zh: 在断裂之步，由同一配置不汲取则依存被维持，断裂事件造成那一次断裂的差别。
laws.en: At the breaking step, drawing nothing from the same configuration keeps the dependence, so the breaking event makes the step-level difference.

hypotheses.zh: 扣除（withhold）是外给的配置变换：只改动一方或一步的部分，过程本身给出由此到达的配置；一同扣除若干部分，是按所列次序逐一应用给定的扣除（withholdAll）。扣除是否让其余不变、次序是否要紧，是每次应用的建模义务。
hypotheses.en: Withholding is a supplied map on configurations: it changes only one party's or one step's part, and the process gives the configurations reached from there; withholding several parts applies it one part after another in the listed order (withholdAll). Whether withholding leaves the rest unchanged, and whether the order matters, are modelling duties of each application.

hypotheses.zh: 检验固定实际所取的动作：动作属于其余的活动。它要求动作在扣除后的配置上可取，并在动作决定步骤（Determined）时才合乎其意，所以外来冲击须写进动作，不写进步骤关系（Hidden）。在 Pool 中下一步的水平不依赖动作，结论不受影响。
hypotheses.en: The test holds the move actually taken fixed: the move belongs to the rest of the activity. It requires the move to be available from the withheld configuration and reads as intended when the move determines the step (Determined), so exogenous shocks belong in the move, not in the step relation (Hidden). In Pool the next level does not depend on the move, so the conclusions are unaffected.

hypotheses.zh: 关系读法是 relational-reading-comparison 的整段读法，经 Web.ConsumingIn 读出。
hypotheses.en: The relational reading is the whole-run reading of relational-reading-comparison, read through Web.ConsumingIn.

hypotheses.zh: 整段层面的检验（扣除事件的汲取后条件是否仍被消耗）与 MakesDifference（扣除配置之中的部分后这一步是否维持依存）是不同的检验；可更新条件的过程中汲取是动作而不是配置的一部分，所以 depletion_is_joint 用的是前者。
hypotheses.en: The run-level test (whether the condition is still consumed with events' draws withheld) and MakesDifference (whether the step keeps the dependence with a part of the configuration withheld) are different tests; in the renewable process the draw is the move, not part of the configuration, so depletion_is_joint uses the former.

does_not_show.zh: 不提出因果理论；更精细的归属（NESS 检验、结构方程中的实际因果）未加入。
does_not_show.en: Proposes no causal theory; finer attribution (the NESS test, actual causation in structural equations) is not added.

does_not_show.zh: 不推出责任、义务或排序。
does_not_show.en: Yields no responsibility, duty or ranking.

does_not_show.zh: 逐步读法不追踪差别制造：在 Pool 中恰取更新量、其部分不造成差别的汲取者，在另一方造成的断裂之步侵蚀。
does_not_show.en: The stepwise reading does not track difference-making: in Pool a drawer taking exactly the renewal, whose part makes no difference, undermines at the break another causes.

does_not_show.zh: 扣除本身使依存落空时（那一部分是支持者），检验不作判断。
does_not_show.en: When withholding the part itself leaves the dependence unmet (the part is a support), the test is silent.

does_not_show.zh: Pool、Shock 与 depleting 是最小见证。
does_not_show.en: Pool, Shock and depleting are minimal witnesses.

detail.zh: 多重决定（Pool.difference_belongs_to_the_joint 的三方运行）：每一方单独都不造成差别，共同活动造成了损失。在一个形成的各事件之间，整段层面没有哪个有限的事件集合造成差别（Renewable.depletion_is_joint、Renewable.no_finite_segment_makes_difference），而断裂事件造成步层面的差别（Renewable.breaking_event_makes_step_difference；独立审查 F7）。
detail.en: Overdetermination (the three-drawer run of Pool.difference_belongs_to_the_joint): no party alone makes the difference, while the joint activity makes the loss. Across a formation's own events no finite set of events makes the run-level difference (Renewable.depletion_is_joint, Renewable.no_finite_segment_makes_difference), while the breaking event makes the step-level difference (Renewable.breaking_event_makes_step_difference; independent review F7).

detail.zh: 不固定动作时动作决定结果（Shock.move_decides）：由同一配置，唯一汲取者的部分在平静的动作下造成差别，在外来冲击下损失被多重决定，它的部分不造成差别（独立审查 F6）。
detail.en: Without the move held fixed, the move decides (Shock.move_decides): from one configuration a lone drawer's part makes the difference under the calm move, and under an exogenous shock the loss is overdetermined and its part makes none (independent review F6).

detail.zh: 独立审查：所审的数学接受；侵蚀与 but-for 的定义须修正（已修正）；散文七处强于 Lean，整合文档中比较表在 (a)(b) 与 but-for 一栏上不公允（已更正）。
detail.en: Independent review: the mathematics under review is accepted; the definitions of undermining and but-for needed repair (repaired); the prose overclaimed in seven places and the integration note's comparison table was unfair in rows (a), (b) and the but-for column (corrected).

detail.zh: 把冲击写进步骤关系，检验又失去意义（Hidden.shock_in_the_step）：同一动作的一步可以更新并汲取，也可以清空条件；动作不决定步骤，唯一汲取者的损失被多重决定，它的部分不造成差别，虽然由扣除后的配置，同一动作的平静结局维持依存（独立审查 G6）。
detail.en: With the shock written into the step relation the test loses its meaning again (Hidden.shock_in_the_step): one move's step can renew and take or empty the condition; the move does not determine the step, the lone drawer's loss is overdetermined and its part makes no difference, though from the withheld configuration the calm outcome of the same move keeps the dependence (independent review G6).

detail.zh: 动作在扣除后不可取时（Tagged.move_unavailable）：每个动作指名它所取自的配置，动作决定步骤并断裂依存，但扣除任何汲取者的部分后都不能取；没有“动作可取”一项时，每个汲取者的部分都会空洞地造成差别；有了它，没有哪一方造成差别，损失也不是多重决定的，而在 Pool.process 中由同一配置它是（独立审查 G6）。
detail.en: When the move is unavailable after withholding (Tagged.move_unavailable): each move names the configuration it is taken from; the move determines the step and breaks the dependence, but no withheld configuration can take it; without the clause that the move can be taken, every drawer's part would make the difference vacuously; with it none does, and the loss is not overdetermined either, while under Pool.process from the same configuration it is (independent review G6).

detail.zh: 独立审查：所审的全部声明接受，公理报告为空；MetSince 须比较那一步的所需（已修正），依存中断一步即开始新的一段（已披露），but-for 须动作可取（已修正）；散文在逐步读法所放弃的、节制、替代、交互与剩余的无需实际汲取的连通上强于 Lean（已在整合文档中更正）。
detail.en: Independent review: every declaration under review is accepted with empty axiom reports; MetSince had to compare the need at that step (repaired), a one-step lapse starts a new tenure (disclosed), and but-for needs the move to be available (repaired); the prose overclaimed on what the stepwise reading gives up, restraint, substitution, interaction and the remaining connection that needs no actual drawing (corrected in the integration note).

detail.zh: 共同定律由左到右一向的条件不能去掉（Blocked.only_together_unbroken、NeedRises.only_together_unmet）：动作决定步骤，前两个汲取者只有一同才造成差别，但单独扣除其中一个后，或者动作不可取，或者所需（升为 5）不被满足，所以同一动作在那里并不断裂依存。
detail.en: The conditions of the joint law's left-to-right direction cannot be dropped (Blocked.only_together_unbroken, NeedRises.only_together_unmet): the move determines the step and the first two drawers make the difference only together, yet with either withheld alone the move cannot be taken, or the need (raised to 5) is not met, so the same move does not break the dependence there.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器实查（回执 20261013T221720.428753Z）：Becoming.Joint 34 项定理（含共同定律、单一部分的定律与 Blocked、NeedRises 反例）公理报告为空；检查器并核对核心纯净。作者反审见整合文档；第二、三、四次独立审查（见来源）指出 but-for 须动作可取并决定步骤、二分须依存在扣除后的配置上成立并被满足，更正见整合文档。
validation_scope.en: Machine-checked by the consolidated Lean 4.29.1 checker (receipt 20261013T221720.428753Z): the 34 theorems of Becoming.Joint, the joint law, the single-part laws and the Blocked and NeedRises counterexamples among them, have empty axiom reports, and the checker verifies core purity. Author counterreview in the integration note; the second, third and fourth independent reviews (listed under sources) found that but-for needs the move available and determining the step, and the dichotomy the dependence held and met at the withheld configuration; the corrections are in the integration note.

next_delta.zh: 加入更精细的归属作为另一种读法，并与关系读法比较；说明在多重决定下，“这一共同活动是消耗”的判断怎样到达各参与者。
next_delta.en: Add finer attribution as another reading and compare it with the relational reading; explain how, under overdetermination, the judgment that a joint activity consumes reaches each participant.

correspondence.zh: but-for 检验与关系读法回答不同的问题：前者问扣除一方的部分是否改变结果，后者问一方实际参与了什么及该条件的去向。多重决定的情形正是“我的一份无关紧要”这一推理的形式。两者都不是因果理论，也不推出责任或义务。关于集体伤害与过度决定的哲学讨论（如 Parfit、Kagan，作者据先前知识，本次未新读）是对照。“but-for 不能代替参与”只对单一部分的、整段层面的检验证明；步层面的检验挑出断裂事件，NESS 一类检验是另外的对手。
correspondence.en: The but-for test and the relational reading answer different questions: whether withholding a party's part changes the outcome, and what a party actually took part in and where the condition went. The overdetermined case is the form of “my share makes no difference”. Neither is a causal theory, and neither yields responsibility or duty. Philosophical work on collective harm and overdetermination (for example Parfit and Kagan, from the author's prior knowledge, not newly read) is the comparison. That “but-for cannot replace participation” is shown only for the single-part, run-level test; the step-level test picks out the breaking event, and NESS-type tests are further rivals.

detail.zh: Keeps、Breaks 沿运行恰是 Web.Kept、Web.Broken（along_kept、along_broken）；Pool 的分类经 Dependence.along 读出。
detail.en: Keeps and Breaks along a run are exactly Web.Kept and Web.Broken (along_kept, along_broken); Pool's classification is read through Dependence.along.

output.zh: 依存可观测量、依存网及其维持、断裂与消耗。
output.en: Dependence observables, webs and their keeping, breaking and consumption.

input.zh: 配置之间的维持与断裂及 but-for 检验。
input.en: Keeping and breaking between configurations, and the but-for test.

detail.zh: depletion_is_joint 用 UnderminingFor 陈述第一个事件对任何周期都不侵蚀。
detail.en: depletion_is_joint uses UnderminingFor to state that the first event undermines for no cycle.

input.zh: 渐进耗竭中事件的读法。
input.en: The reading of events in gradual depletion.

detail.zh: 该结果的 jointly_consuming 表明联合消耗没有单一的消耗者；本结果表明多重决定下 but-for 不归属差别，而关系读法仍把每个汲取者计为消耗，承接其“差别制造归属”的下一步。
detail.en: That result's jointly_consuming shows joint consumption has no single consumer; this one shows that under overdetermination but-for attributes no difference while the relational reading still counts each drawer as consuming, taking up its next step on difference-making attribution.

detail.zh: 用单一部分的、整段层面的 but-for 差别制造代替参与，不能满足该结果所记录的 C 的排序；那些排序把 Ren 所采纳的问题形式化（整合文档 §8.5、§11、§12）。
detail.en: Replacing participation by single-part, run-level but-for difference-making cannot meet the C rankings recorded in that result, which formalize the problem Ren adopted (integration note §§8.5, 11, 12).

detail.zh: 逐步读法不追踪差别制造（Pool.within_share_undermines）；步层面的检验与逐步读法都扣下断裂事件，但逐步读法也扣下恰取更新量的汲取者。
detail.en: The stepwise reading does not track difference-making (Pool.within_share_undermines); the step-level test and the stepwise reading both withhold the breaking event, but the stepwise reading also withholds a drawer taking exactly the renewal.

detail.zh: 整段层面的结局由尾部决定（Renewable.no_finite_segment_makes_difference），与视界结果是同一事实。
detail.en: The run-level outcome is fixed by the tail (Renewable.no_finite_segment_makes_difference), the same fact as the horizon result.

history.zh: 2026-10-14，一般定律（一般定律计划 L2 流，由整合会话分派；AI 撰写，Claude Opus 5.5）：审计的边界项（“差别由共同活动造成”只在 Pool 中示出）由一条对每个过程成立的定律回答。but-for 检验推广到一同扣除的若干部分（withholdAll、MakesDifferenceTogether）；differenceOnlyTogether_iff 确切说明若干部分何时只有一同才造成差别；makesDifference_iff、breaksBy_iff_level 与 keeps_iff_not_breaks 给出不需动作决定步骤的单一部分检验；two_le_length 与 Overdetermined.only_together 随之成立；Pool 的 first_two_only_together 是实例；Blocked 与 NeedRises 表明定律由左到右一向不能去掉动作可取与所需被满足。主张改写为定律在先；原有结果、见证与反例不变。合并时 Joint 的证明绑定须改指新的合并回执。
history.en: 14 October 2026, general law (general-laws plan, stream L2, assigned by the integrating session; AI-authored, Claude Opus 5.5): the audit's borderline finding (that the difference belongs to the joint activity was shown only in Pool) is answered by a law for every process. The but-for test extends to parts withheld together (withholdAll, MakesDifferenceTogether); differenceOnlyTogether_iff states exactly when parts make the difference only together; makesDifference_iff, breaksBy_iff_level and keeps_iff_not_breaks give the single-part test without determinacy; two_le_length and Overdetermined.only_together follow; Pool's first_two_only_together is an instance; Blocked and NeedRises show that availability and a met need cannot be dropped from the law's left-to-right direction. The claim is rewritten law first; earlier results, witnesses and counterexamples are unchanged. The Joint proof binding must be re-pointed to a new consolidated receipt at landing.

history.en: 14 October 2026 readability migration to schema 2 (general-laws plan: migration of the records the growth ratchet stopped): The long title became a short name with the statement first; the claim was split into 12 laws; limitations, per-round receipts and review notes went to does-not-show items, hypotheses, a standard boundary, the evidence paragraph and history. No law, premise, status, proof binding or source hash changed. Three laws now state hypotheses their theorems carry that the old claim left implicit: the single-part law and the dichotomy, that the step breaks the dependence; breaking by level, that the dependence holds and is met. In the counterexamples the two review summaries say “the mathematics under review” and “every declaration under review” in place of the round labels P7, P8, P9 and P7b, and drop their section numbers (§8.5, §11, §12). Every earlier sentence is mapped in the migration table [joint-difference-making.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/development/becoming-general-laws-plan/readability/migrations/joint-difference-making.md); the exact earlier record is the last text_versions entry.
